journal: Journal of child and adolescent psychopharmacology
our_summary: The companion randomised trial of the same drug was stopped for futility at its planned interim analysis, and this study was stopped with it.
Stopped after other trials reported worse outcomes when the two antibodies were combined; the authors conclude the combination is detrimental.
Halted for futility after the first interim analysis.
Terminated after suspected cases of Wernicke's encephalopathy in other trials of the same drug.

journal: American journal of transplantation : official journal of the American Society of Transplantation and the American Society of Transplant Surgeons
our_summary: Halted early because of graft rejection in the treatment groups.
Enrolment halted after a pre-planned futility analysis showed limited activity of the drug.
Terminated at the data monitoring committee's request because of more serious adverse events and deaths with the drug, and no sign of efficacy.
Stopped at the interim analysis for futility (low probability of a positive primary outcome).
Terminated early for minimal antitumour activity and a narrow therapeutic range, although tolerable.
Terminated early after a new treatment for the same infection was approved, which, as the registry says, stopped further recruitment.
Stopped early for a safety concern (pulmonary hypertension in newborns in the treatment group) while benefit on the primary outcome had become unlikely.
Stopped for safety after the data and safety monitoring board recommended termination at the last planned interim analysis.
Ended after its first phase because the treatment landscape changed: PD-1 inhibitors had become the standard to build on in melanoma.
Terminated early because of toxicity of the drug's delivery vehicle found in a non-human primate study.
Accrual to the expansion part was stopped because it did not reach the prespecified number of responders.
Closed for futility: no confirmed responses in the brain at the recommended dose, so the criterion for the second stage was not met.
Stopped after interim analyses that did not meet their criteria in some cohorts, with more effective treatments available for these patients.
Closed early for low accrual and an evaluation of the risk-benefit profile, as evidence grew that the drug class works mainly in a genetic subgroup.
Stopped at the first interim analysis after crossing the prespecified futility/harm threshold (more primary outcome events with the drug than with placebo).
Stopped early because of the sponsor's financial problems.
Terminated for the sponsor's portfolio reprioritisation, not for safety or efficacy.

journal: The journal of prevention of Alzheimer's disease
our_summary: Terminated when the companion phase 3 trial of the same drug reported negative topline results.
Terminated for the sponsor's business portfolio reprioritisation, not for safety or efficacy.
Discontinued after the sponsor company was acquired.
